featuredTestimonial.quote: “It didn’t just speak to me - it shimmered.  I’ve kept it like a piece of art.”

body: Serafina is an artist whose work weaves together art, symbolism, and intuitive insight, drawing inspiration from sacred places around the world.
Her work is shaped by a lifelong study of tarot, myth, and visual storytelling — creating readings that feel intimate, thoughtful, and deeply personal.
quote: “Every reading, to me, is like standing before a living work of art - where fate, choice,
and reflection meet through the language of symbols.”
“I felt like the reading was crafted just for me. The words,
the imagery, the clarity — it was beautiful and affirming.”
